description: Generic radio button group that renders a set of RadioOption items with label, help text, error message, and horizontal or vertical layout. Appearance=Segmented renders a single-choice segmented control for a value; switching content belongs to TmTabs Variant=Pill.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Radio group name attribute (shared by all radio inputs).

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Group label shown above the options.

parameters.name: HelpText
parameters.description: Help text shown below the label.

parameters.name: Error
parameters.description: Validation error message. When set, the radiogroup container gets aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby pointing at the rendered message's stable id.

parameters.name: AnnounceError
parameters.description: When true (default), the rendered Error message carries role="alert" so screen readers announce it assertively. Set false when the host moves focus to the group itself: the error is then read through aria-describedby and the live region would announce the same text twice. With false the message still renders, keeps its error styling and stays referenced by aria-describedby; only the role attribute is dropped.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Marks the radio group as required. Shows a required marker on the label and sets aria-required on the radiogroup element.

parameters.name: Appearance
parameters.description: Radio (default) renders radio buttons. Segmented renders a single-choice segmented control for picking a value.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

examples.title: Error without live-region announcement (host focuses the group itself)

notes: The error span renders with a stable id (tm-radio-error-{guid}); the radiogroup container references it through aria-describedby and sets aria-invalid="true" while an Error shows.
Inside a TmFormField with a rendered error, the group additionally describes the field-level error message (cascaded as TmFormFieldErrorId) when it has no own Error.
